category_title: Proactive students who utilize modeling and mentor support to catch up
scenario_title: After-school math tutoring and whiteboard modeling to catch up
minimal_context: The student is working on a math problem on a whiteboard during an after-school tutoring session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the next math problem for our after-school tutoring session.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Mr. Lopez keeps me on track, making sure I get to my math teacher whenever there is free time to help me catch up—he looks out [for me].

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and try to solve it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Writing the math problem on the whiteboards) I need to make sure I understand the content.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Our time is up for today, you need to pack up.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Rewriting the math problem on the whiteboards) I can't go yet, I am rewriting the math problem on the whiteboards, making sure I understood the content before I left.
